extensionDescription.message: Lets NDS agents work in their own tab groups of your browser, through the NDS host on this device.

mismatch.message: The NDS host speaks contract $1 and this extension does not. Update the extension, or run `nds-browser-use install` for a newer host.

setupNeeded.message: The NDS host is not running on this device. Agents need it to work in your browser.

controlOn.message: Agents may work in their own tab groups.

controlOff.message: Agents cannot act, and their tabs are released.

tabOwnerNote.message: Agents cannot use it. Move it into an agent's group to share it.

recordedDone.message: Recorded $1 actions. The agent reads them with `recorder events`.

recordHint.message: Your clicks, typing and navigations here become steps the agent can replay.

refusedNoAgentTab.message: Open a tab of an agent group to record what you do there.

refusedSession.message: This agent group has no open session.

refusedBusy.message: The agent is running code; try again in a moment.

refusedHost.message: The NDS host is not connected.

refusedTimeout.message: The NDS host did not answer.

privateNote.message: Agents still work there, but their activity journal keeps no content of them.

activityNone.message: Nothing yet. Steps appear here in the full observation profile.

activityNoTab.message: Open a tab of an agent group to see what its agent did.

activityHost.message: The NDS host did not answer.

activityHint.message: Newest first. Agents read all of it with `nds-browser-use -s <project> activity`.

observationFull.message: A full journal on this device, secrets removed.

observationStandard.message: Only names, timings and outcomes, no page content.

observationOff.message: Nothing is collected, and the recorder is off.
